requirements.statement: A Trainee signs in with their own platform account and their data is private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is required to sign in before reaching Trainee features
A signed-in Trainee cannot see another Trainee's data without being an accepted coach link

requirements.statement: A Trainee sets their own daily calorie and macro (protein, carbs, fat) targets

criteria.must: A Trainee can save a daily calorie target and protein, carbs and fat targets
Saved targets are shown back to the Trainee

requirements.statement: A Trainee can update their targets whenever their goals change

criteria.must: A Trainee can change a previously saved target and the new value is what is shown afterward

requirements.statement: A Trainee manually logs a meal with its calories and macros, without any food database lookup

criteria.must: A Trainee can create a meal log entry with a name, calories, protein, carbs and fat
No food database search or barcode input is offered anywhere in meal logging

requirements.statement: A Trainee manually logs a workout as either strength exercises with sets/reps/weight, or a cardio duration

criteria.must: A Trainee can create a strength workout log entry with one or more exercises, each with sets, reps and weight
A Trainee can create a cardio workout log entry with a duration

requirements.statement: A Trainee can edit or delete a meal or workout log entry to correct mistakes

criteria.must: A Trainee can edit an existing meal log entry and the change is reflected afterward
A Trainee can delete an existing meal or workout log entry and it no longer appears

requirements.statement: A Trainee sees a daily summary of logged calories and macros against their targets

criteria.must: The daily summary shows totals from that day's logged meals compared against the Trainee's current targets

requirements.statement: A Trainee sees a weekly history of their nutrition and workout logs

criteria.must: The weekly history shows a summary for each of the trailing 7 days

requirements.statement: A Trainee can invite a Coach by their platform email or username

criteria.must: A Trainee can submit a coach invite naming an email or username
The submitted invite appears in a pending state until the coach responds

requirements.statement: A Coach can see invites sent to them and accept the ones they want

criteria.must: A Coach can see a list of pending invites addressed to them
A Coach can accept a pending invite, after which the link is no longer pending

requirements.statement: A Trainee can revoke a Coach's access at any time

criteria.must: A Trainee can revoke an accepted coach link
After revocation the former Coach can no longer read that Trainee's data

requirements.statement: A Coach has read-only access to an accepting Trainee's targets, logs, daily summary, and weekly history

criteria.must: An accepted Coach can view a linked Trainee's current targets
An accepted Coach can view a linked Trainee's daily summary and weekly history
A Coach has no control to set or edit a linked Trainee's targets or log entries

requirements.statement: A Coach can leave feedback for a Trainee

criteria.must: An accepted Coach can submit feedback for a linked Trainee

requirements.statement: A Trainee can view feedback their Coach has left

criteria.must: Feedback submitted by an accepted Coach appears to the Trainee it was left for
